content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the improper handling of class references in the `CACHE_CLASSES` map within the `Configuration` class. Initially, the map stored strong references to `Class<?>` objects, which led to class-loaders being retained in memory even when they were no longer needed, resulting in memory leaks. The patch fixes this by changing the map to store `WeakReference<Class<?>>` instead, allowing the garbage collector to reclaim memory for classes that are no longer in use, thus preventing class-loader leaks.
